title: Distributed Gaze / Observation Without a Single Observer

source_refs.author: Michel Foucault and surveillance-studies scholarship
source_refs.title: Discipline and Punish; distributed surveillance research

observed_structure: observation is distributed across devices, people, or records
no single watcher controls the entire field
behavior changes because visibility may persist after the observer leaves
cinematic_affordances: screens or reflections showing incomplete coverage
camera position inherited by another object
behavior changes after an indicator activates
cultural_scope: surveillance context must specify institution, technology, and affected population
transferable_structure: observation becomes a networked condition that persists beyond any one observer and changes conduct through uncertain visibility
non_transferable_surface: generic CCTV montages, glowing red camera lights, or unsupported claims of total surveillance
